rect.data-description: the port's A/L (Active/Link) lamp. Table 23, '8-Port 10-Gigabit Ethernet MPA LEDs': off - port is not enabled; green on - port is enabled and the link is up; amber on - port is enabled and the link is down. Cisco adds, on the sibling tables for the XFP and 20-port MPAs, that the A/L 'will blink green and amber when there is traffic activity'; this card's own table omits that row, so blink is not carried as a state here. This one is port 0's.

circle.data-description: the MPA's STATUS lamp. Table 23: off - MPA power is off; green on - MPA is ready and operational; amber on - the MPA power is on and working is being configured. Cisco's wording, kept as printed.
